title: R&M — Merril and Ring Forestland Management: additional real forest blocks found in the full 1,171-row raw log (Phase 2 import prep)
notes: Wave 1 seeded only 2 M&R zones (Kaiuma, Waihopai) from the List sheet's Forest Name/Code table - but that List sheet is actually just a GL billing-code reference with only 2 of the 20 real Forest codes documented. Exporting the full 1,171-row NOW sheet and sampling Location/Comments text for each undocumented code identified 6 more real, named forest access roads in the Marlborough back country (Birdlip Rd, Kytes Creek Rd, Musgrove Rd/Ben Redwood Forest, Pukaka Valley Rd, Chestnut Rd, Branch Forest/River Rd).

Geocoding these specific private forestry access roads returned only generic/low-confidence fallback matches for 5 of 6 (repeated identical 'Tyntesfield Road, Waihopai Valley' catch-all, or an unrelated roading-contractor office address) - not trusted, not used. Four are created UNPLACED (no lat/lng, named block only - the same supported pattern already used for STAND's Borlace Forest) rather than guessing coordinates. Chestnut Rd and Branch Forest share one confident nearby locality match ('Blowhard, Wairau Valley' - explicitly linked in the raw log via the comment 'Recon - Branch Forest - same as chestnut rd') and are placed there approximately with a large radius.
